# Dorthe Svenstrup

Dorthe Svenstrup is Ledende overlæge (Chief Physician/Senior Consultant) at Hjertesygdomme (Cardiology), part of [[hospitalsenhed-midt|Hospitalsenhed Midt]][^src1]. She holds a ph.d. degree, which is noted alongside her title in one of her two listed mentions[^src2].

She appears in the AFDK 2024 report (pages 66-70) as a member of the steering group ("styregruppen") described in this section, which documents patient representatives' perspectives on structured patient education[^src1][^src2]. The surrounding chunk context explains that this part of the report covers how Hospitalsenhed Midt has implemented systematic patient education since 2012, presents the members of the steering group, and discusses methodological limitations of the AFDK database — the nationwide Danish quality registry for atrial fibrillation operating under Dansk Cardiologisk Selskab and approved by Sundhedsstyrelsen. Svenstrup's role as Ledende overlæge at Hjertesygdomme, Hospitalsenhed Midt, situates her within this broader effort to strengthen structured teaching shortly after diagnosis in order to improve patient satisfaction and self-sufficiency.

Beyond her job title and workplace, no further claims, timeline events, or additional relationships are documented for her in the corpus.
